objective: Assess current locked EGO manual-goal spline publication and offline known-obstacle geometry, then capture a post-spline localization, mapping, and VINS telemetry health timeline. No control or trajectory execution.

runs.finding: Delayed goal probe started after localization locked with right_stale; map had reset and zero occupied points. No goal/spline; excluded from planner result.

finding.later_input_failure: mapping gate closed on normalized_cost_exceeded; EGO logged odom/depth loss and EMERGENCY_STOP.

runs.interpretation: The telemetry and health code explain why this sample caused the current fail-closed gate. The reason for the single negative Ceres timing value is unknown. EGO depth/pose synchronization loss was logged earlier in the run and has not been causally linked to the later localization lock.

qualification: Planner-only diagnostics and offline comparisons to known SDF collision primitives. No trajectory server, controller, PX4 bridge, setpoint publisher, runtime truth input, or trajectory execution. Does not establish map coverage, free/unknown-space safety, actual vehicle clearance, trajectory tracking, or GOAL D/E/F acceptance.
control_isolation: The run harness launches the debug sensor stack, VINS, localization, mapping adapters, and ego_planner advanced_param.launch.py only. That launch file starts ego_planner_node; no trajectory server, controller, PX4 bridge, setpoint publisher, or runtime truth subscriber was launched. #283 runtime node/topic list was not captured because the container-side post-run evaluator lacked scipy; offline geometry was completed on the host with SciPy 1.8.0.
next_step: Reproduce and instrument the negative solve_seconds sample while retaining the fail-closed gate; diagnose the earlier EGO occupancy/pose synchronization stall separately; then collect free/unknown, coverage, and persistence evidence before freezing GOAL F thresholds and formal D/E tests.
